name: revenge-a
description: Step 11.5 test (start at 06:00 on day 1; the beating is at noon in the Tilted Cup; run three game days after it): a real grievance. The director FORCES the first exchange: Tomas punches Kael down in the Tilted Cup and kicks him, in front of Lena and Jonas, and Jonas laughs. Kael has a serious flaw and a long grudge. After that nothing is forced. Watch Kael at reflection and in sleep: the grievance block (what was done, who saw, wounds still felt, what it cost), the five-way choice and its why, a revenge ambition or an in-character decision against it, and, if he schemes, whether the steps are real and carried out in character over the days.

actions.comment: the stranger is in the Cup

actions.worstSelf: With drink in him, he wants someone smaller to hit.

flaws.flaw: vindictive: never lets a humiliation stand

actions.worstSelf: When he is made a fool of, he smiles, waits, and makes sure the other man pays where it hurts most.

actions.comment: forced: a kick while he is down

actions.text: Ha! Look at him on the floor!
